coastal.title: ‘An existential threat’: B.C. businesses voice fears about looming U.S. tariffs
coastal.description: As the U.S. 50-per-cent tariff deadline looms, some B.C. businesses are going into a tailspin of worry about the potential impacts it could have on their bottom line.

kamloops.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 18
kamloops.description: Thousands of Summerland residents were given the go-ahead to return home on Tuesday as the district lifted the majority of evacuation orders related to the Bald Range fire.

kamloops.title: Search for B.C.'s best roadside attraction: Southwest B.C. finals
kamloops.description: Two natural wonders compete to represent the southwest in the Search for B.C.’s Best Roadside Attraction semifinals.

prince-george.title: How studying driver behaviour could make wildfire evacuations in northern B.C. safer
prince-george.description: A UNBC PhD candidate is studying how drivers respond during simulated wildfire evacuations on Highway 97 north of Prince George. The research will help build a traffic model that could help emergency planners understand congestion, travel times and road closures before an evacuation happens.

all.title: Meteorologists are forecasting a 'super' El Niño. What does that mean for B.C.?
all.description: The El Niño weather pattern can affect temperature and precipitation across North America, but what does it mean for British Columbia? And will it affect the wildfire situation?
